ocr.notes: Minor errors (McCocle's, Court-Honse, fina!, as it he was).

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that the final deposit of $300 a side was made at McCoole's new house for the Feb. 23 prize fight between Tom Allen and Charlie Gallagher, with the betting slightly in Allen's favor.

metadata.notes: Running head reads 'The Missouri Republican--St. Louis, February 17, 1869'.

facts.fact: The articles of agreement for the Allen-Gallagher fight were read and the final deposit of $300 a side was made at Mike McCoole's new house, opposite the Court-House, with the fight set for Feb. 23
places: McCoole's, opposite the Court-House, St. Louis

notes: Both men are again called 'of Cleveland'. Allen was said to look in excellent condition and Gallagher somewhat over-trained.
